example.title: Eitol Towers: red modern condominium block in Hillcrest
example.place: San Diego, San Diego County, CA

brief: A 2000s five-storey modern condominium building: three tall blocks clad in glossy red panels with punched square windows, joined by recessed glass balconies, a concrete podium with planted terraces. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
